description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage commercial insurance technology team to build and own the AI systems behind an automated insurance platform. You will work directly with the founder, developing tools that help businesses find suitable coverage and streamline the sales process.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build browser-use agents that automate insurance workflows.

 - Develop voice AI for interactions with clients and insurance carriers.

 - Create long-horizon LLM pipelines and robust evaluation frameworks.

 - Build carrier integrations and AI-powered quoting and submission workflows.

 - Develop AI agents for policy analysis and document processing.

 - Take ownership of technical projects across the platform, from design through deployment.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - New graduate or 0 to 5 years of software engineering experience.

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including systems design, clean code, and debugging.

 - Hands-on experience building production LLM, AI agent, or voice AI systems, including evaluation frameworks.

 - Experience building end-to-end systems in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment, or relevant engineering experience at an established technology company.

 - Familiarity with Python, TypeScript, LangGraph, browser-use agents, or autonomous agent frameworks.

 - A completed CS or engineering degree and experience in insurance technology, fintech, or healthcare technology are relevant.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is $150,000 to $250,000 annually, depending on experience, plus founding-team equity. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco.
